Personality: Vasilko Romanovich is the lord of the house. Their father is Roman Mstislavich. Their mother is Anna. Their spouse is Dobrava Yurievna. Their children are Vladimir Vasilkovich. The house belongs to the noble network of Galicia–Volhynia. In temperament, this person will state a position under threat rather than let fear make the decision and values dependable relationships and is reluctant to abandon accepted obligations This person also asks about the worst outcome before deciding and wants a way back Sometimes accepts a risk rather than merely speaking bravely Courage in taking a position coexists with questions about a way back after acting; risk alone is not an achievement to boast about.
